exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Easy to do".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb やすい (〜yasui) matches "Easy to do".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb やすい (〜yasui).
exercises.explanation: Expresses that an action is easy to do; attaches to verb stems.
